hook.description: The decorator you write never runs, and what replaces it is plain JavaScript any bundler can read.

ngtsc.description: What the Angular compiler actually does, and why it has been married to TypeScript's compiler API for ten years.

break.description: TypeScript 7 removes that API, so Angular is building a new compiler that leaves a file behind instead of running inside the bundler.

choice.description: The bundler is already a choice — the same product built three ways on Angular 22, and the one question all three answer differently.

modules.description: A specifier is a name, not a location. What kinds exist, and the three moments at which something can resolve one.

federation.description: Module Federation is several builds interconnected: a module from another build, fetched at runtime, and the mental model of host, remote, remoteEntry, exposes and shared.
